الهاججن (form XI)
# اِلْهَاجَجْنَ (ilhājajna) /il.haː.d͡ʒad͡ʒ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
# اِلْهَاجِجْنَ (ilhājijna) /il.haː.d͡ʒid͡ʒ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِلْهَاجَّ (ilhājja)
